aria-label.zh-CN: 表格的可访问名称；没有 aria-label 与 aria-labelledby 时，有 title 的表格用 title 命名。
aria-label.en-US: The accessible name of the table. Without aria-label and aria-labelledby, a table with a title is named by the title.

aria-labelledby.zh-CN: 表格的 aria-labelledby，优先于 title。
aria-labelledby.en-US: aria-labelledby of the table. It wins over title.

bordered.zh-CN: 是否展示外边框和列边框。
bordered.en-US: Whether to show the outer border and the column borders.

cell.zh-CN: 数据单元格的内容，对所有数据列调用，参数含 text、record、index、column、expandIcon、isHovering 等，用 column.dataIndex 或 column.key 区分列；不处理的列需要自己渲染 text。列设置 useFullRender 时 snippet 替换整个单元格，参数里的 selection、indentText、expandIcon 用于摆放选择框、缩进和展开按钮。
cell.en-US: The content of a data cell, called for every data column, with text, record, index, column, expandIcon, isHovering and more; tell the columns apart with column.dataIndex or column.key. Render text for the columns the snippet leaves alone. With useFullRender on a column the snippet replaces the whole cell, and the selection, indentText and expandIcon arguments place the checkbox, the indent and the expand button.

childrenRecordName.zh-CN: 树形表格中，数据项里表示子级数据的字段名。
childrenRecordName.en-US: The field of a record that holds its child records in a tree table.

clickGroupedRowToExpand.zh-CN: 点击分组行时展开或收起该组。
clickGroupedRowToExpand.en-US: Clicking a group row expands or collapses the group.

columns.zh-CN: 列配置，详见 Column。列只含数据，列内的节点用 Table 的 cell、headerCell、sortIcon、filterIcon、filterDropdown 等 snippet 渲染。
columns.en-US: The column configuration, see Column. A column holds data only; markup goes to the cell, headerCell, sortIcon, filterIcon, filterDropdown and other snippets of Table.

components.zh-CN: 覆盖 Table 的组成元素，如 header 与 body 的 outer、wrapper、row、cell，值为标签名，该元素替换对应位置的默认标签。
components.en-US: Replaces the elements Table renders, such as the outer, wrapper, row and cell of the header and the body, with a tag name that replaces the default tag of that part.

currentPage.zh-CN: 当前页码，可用 `bind:currentPage` 双向绑定，翻页时写回。与 `pagination.currentPage` 同时传入时以它为准；`pagination` 没有 `currentPage` 时，Table 仍自己对 dataSource 分页，父级改值会翻页；`pagination` 传了 `currentPage` 时是受控分页，Table 不对 dataSource 分页。
currentPage.en-US: The current page, bound with `bind:currentPage` and written back when the page changes. It wins over `pagination.currentPage`. Without `currentPage` in `pagination`, Table still pages dataSource itself and a change from the parent turns the page; with it, the pager is controlled and Table does not page dataSource.

dataSource.zh-CN: 数据。请为每一条数据分配一个独立的 key，或使用 rowKey 指定一个作为主键的属性名。原地增删元素（push、splice）会重新排序和筛选；只修改记录字段时，单元格显示新值，但不重新排序和筛选。
dataSource.en-US: The data. Give every record a unique key, or name the primary key field with rowKey. Rows added or removed in place (push, splice) are sorted and filtered again; a record field changed in place shows in its cell but does not sort or filter again.

defaultExpandAllGroupRows.zh-CN: 默认是否展开所有分组行，动态加载数据时不生效。
defaultExpandAllGroupRows.en-US: Whether all group rows start expanded. Has no effect on data loaded later.

defaultExpandAllRows.zh-CN: 默认是否展开所有行，动态加载数据时不生效。
defaultExpandAllRows.en-US: Whether all rows start expanded. Has no effect on data loaded later.

direction.zh-CN: 文字方向，默认值取 ConfigProvider 的 direction，可在此单独配置。
direction.en-US: The text direction. Defaults to the direction of ConfigProvider and can be set here per table.

empty.zh-CN: 无数据时展示的内容，不提供时显示语言包的空文案，提供空 snippet 时不显示任何内容。
empty.en-US: The content shown without data. Without the snippet the locale's empty text shows; an empty snippet shows nothing.

expandAllGroupRows.en-US: Whether all group rows are expanded.

expandCellFixed.zh-CN: 展开按钮所在列是否固定，取值与 Column 的 fixed 相同。
expandCellFixed.en-US: Whether the column of the expand button is fixed, with the same values as the fixed field of a column.

expandIcon.zh-CN: 传 false 隐藏展开按钮；传 snippet 替换展开按钮的图标，参数 expanded，自定义图标不带旋转动画。
expandIcon.en-US: Pass false to hide the expand buttons, or a snippet with expanded to replace the icon of an expand button. A custom icon does not rotate.

expandRowByClick.zh-CN: 点击行时是否展开可展开行。
expandRowByClick.en-US: Whether clicking a row expands an expandable row.

expandedRow.zh-CN: 展开行的内容，参数含 record、index、expanded；传入后每个可展开的行都有展开按钮，输出为空时该行不渲染。
expandedRow.en-US: The content of an expanded row, with record, index and expanded. Once given, every expandable row has an expand button; empty output leaves the row out.

expandedRowKeys.zh-CN: 展开的行 key 数组，可用 `bind:expandedRowKeys` 双向绑定，包含已展开的分组 key；不传时行展开不受控。
expandedRowKeys.en-US: The keys of the expanded rows, bound with `bind:expandedRowKeys`, group keys included. Leave it out for uncontrolled expansion.

filterDropdown.zh-CN: 筛选面板，用于 filterDropdown 为 true 的列，参数含 column、临时筛选值 tempFilteredValue 与 onTempFilteredValueChange、onConfirm、onClear、onClose、onReset，用 column 区分列。
filterDropdown.en-US: The filter panel of a column with filterDropdown set to true, with column, the temporary value tempFilteredValue and onTempFilteredValueChange, onConfirm, onClear, onClose and onReset; tell the columns apart with column.

filterDropdownItem.zh-CN: 筛选菜单中的一项，参数含 text、value、checked、level、onChange 等；传入后替换所有筛选项。
filterDropdownItem.en-US: An item of the filter menu, with text, value, checked, level, onChange and more. Once given, it replaces every item.

filterIcon.zh-CN: 筛选按钮的内容，参数含 filtered 与 column。
filterIcon.en-US: The content of the filter button, with filtered and column.

footer.zh-CN: 表格尾部，可以是纯文本，或带参数 pageData（当前页数据）的 snippet。
footer.en-US: The table footer: plain text, or a snippet with the records of the current page as pageData.

groupBy.zh-CN: 分组依据，可以是数据项中的字段名，或返回字符串、数字的函数。
groupBy.en-US: The grouping rule: a record field name, or a function that returns a string or a number.

groupSection.zh-CN: 分组行的内容，参数含 groupKey 与 group（该组的行 key）。
groupSection.en-US: The content of a group row, with groupKey and group (the row keys of the group).

groupSectionColumn.zh-CN: 分组行唯一一列的列配置，返回值不含 title、children、dataIndex。
groupSectionColumn.en-US: The column configuration of the single cell of a group row. The returned object has no title, children or dataIndex.

headerCell.zh-CN: 列标题的内容，参数含 column、title 与 sorter、filter、selection；不处理的列需要自己渲染 title。列设置 useFullRender 时 snippet 替换整个表头单元格，sorter、filter、selection 用于摆放排序、筛选与选择控件。
headerCell.en-US: The content of a column title, with column, title and sorter, filter, selection. Render title for the columns the snippet leaves alone. With useFullRender on a column the snippet replaces the whole header cell, and sorter, filter and selection place the sort, filter and selection controls.

headerStyle.zh-CN: 所有表头单元格（包括固定表头）的内联样式字符串。
headerStyle.en-US: Inline style string of every header cell, fixed headers included.

hideExpandedColumn.zh-CN: 表格可展开时，展开按钮默认与第一列内容渲染在同一个单元格；设为 false 时展开按钮单独占一列。
hideExpandedColumn.en-US: In an expandable table the expand button shares the first cell by default; set false to render it as its own column.

indentSize.zh-CN: 树形数据每一层的缩进宽度，单位为像素。
indentSize.en-US: The indent of each tree level, in pixels.

keepDOM.zh-CN: 折叠行时是否保留被折叠的 DOM。
keepDOM.en-US: Whether collapsing a row keeps its DOM.

loading.en-US: Whether the table shows its loading state.

onChange.zh-CN: 分页、排序、筛选变化时调用，参数含 pagination、filters、sorter 与 extra.changeType。
onChange.en-US: Called when the page, the sorting or the filters change. The argument holds pagination, filters, sorter and extra.changeType.

onExpand.zh-CN: 点击展开按钮时调用，参数为展开状态、行数据（分组行为 groupKey 对象）和鼠标事件。
onExpand.en-US: Called when an expand button is clicked, with the expanded state, the record (an object with groupKey for a group row) and the mouse event.

onExpandedRowsChange.zh-CN: 展开的行变化时调用，参数为展开的行数据数组。
onExpandedRowsChange.en-US: Called when the expanded rows change, with the array of expanded records.

onGroupedRow.zh-CN: 类似 onRow，单独用于分组行，返回值是 tr 的属性与小写监听器。index 在未开启 virtualized 时是分组序号，开启后是该行在虚拟列表中的位置。
onGroupedRow.en-US: Like onRow, for group rows. The returned object holds the attributes and lowercase listeners of the tr. index is the group's ordinal, or its position among the virtual list's rows when virtualized is on.

onHeaderRow.zh-CN: 设置表头行的属性与小写监听器，返回值会合并到表头行（不含 style）。
onHeaderRow.en-US: Sets the attributes and lowercase listeners of a header row. The returned object (without style) is merged into the row.

onRow.zh-CN: 设置数据行的属性与小写监听器（如 onclick、onmouseenter），第三个参数为行状态。返回的监听器在行自身的处理和 onRowXxx 回调之后调用。
onRow.en-US: Sets the attributes and lowercase listeners (such as onclick and onmouseenter) of a data row; the third argument is the row state. The returned listeners run after the row's own handling and the onRowXxx callbacks.

onRowContextMenu.zh-CN: 数据行触发右键菜单时调用，先于 onRow 返回的 oncontextmenu 调用。
onRowContextMenu.en-US: Called when a data row opens the context menu, before the oncontextmenu returned by onRow.

onRowDoubleClick.zh-CN: 双击数据行时调用，先于 onRow 返回的 ondblclick 调用。
onRowDoubleClick.en-US: Called when a data row is double-clicked, before the ondblclick returned by onRow.

onRowMouseEnter.zh-CN: 鼠标进入数据行时调用，先于 onRow 返回的 onmouseenter 调用。
onRowMouseEnter.en-US: Called when the pointer enters a data row, before the onmouseenter returned by onRow.

onRowMouseLeave.zh-CN: 鼠标离开数据行时调用，先于 onRow 返回的 onmouseleave 调用。
onRowMouseLeave.en-US: Called when the pointer leaves a data row, before the onmouseleave returned by onRow.

onScroll.zh-CN: 虚拟化表体的纵向偏移变化时调用，参数为 scrollOffset，横向滚动不触发。
onScroll.en-US: Called when the vertical offset of a virtualized body changes, with scrollOffset. A horizontal scroll does not call it.

pagination.zh-CN: 分页配置，传 false 关闭分页。
pagination.en-US: The pagination configuration. Pass false to turn pagination off.

paginationContent.zh-CN: 替换分页信息与分页器，参数 pagination 可直接展开给 Pagination；与 pagination 属性同名空间，所以单独命名。
paginationContent.en-US: Replaces the pagination info and the Pagination. The pagination argument can be spread on a Pagination as is. It is named apart from the pagination prop, which shares the namespace.

prefixCls.en-US: The prefix of the class names.

resizable.zh-CN: 是否开启列宽伸缩，需要伸缩的列必须提供 width。传入对象时可配置 onResize、onResizeStart、onResizeStop 与 handlerClassName。
resizable.en-US: Whether columns can be resized; a resizable column needs a width. An object configures onResize, onResizeStart, onResizeStop and handlerClassName.

rowExpandable.zh-CN: 判断某一行是否可展开，返回 false 时不渲染该行的展开按钮。
rowExpandable.en-US: Tells whether a row can be expanded. A row that returns false has no expand button.

rowKey.zh-CN: 行 key 的取值：数据项的字段名，或返回字符串、数字的函数。
rowKey.en-US: The row key: a record field name, or a function that returns a string or a number.

rowSelection.zh-CN: 行选择配置，传 true 使用默认配置，详见 rowSelection。
rowSelection.en-US: The row selection configuration. Pass true for the defaults, see rowSelection.

rowSpanHover.zh-CN: 悬停在带 rowspan 的单元格上时，高亮它跨越的所有行。
rowSpanHover.en-US: Hovering a cell with rowspan highlights every row the cell spans.

scroll.zh-CN: 滚动区域配置，x 为横向宽度，y 为纵向高度，详见 scroll。
scroll.en-US: The scroll area: x is the width and y the height, see scroll.

selectedRowKeys.zh-CN: 选中行的 key 数组，可用 `bind:selectedRowKeys` 双向绑定，勾选时写回。与 `rowSelection.selectedRowKeys` 同时传入时以它为准；需要同时传 `rowSelection` 才显示选择列。
selectedRowKeys.en-US: The keys of the selected rows, bound with `bind:selectedRowKeys` and written back when the selection changes. It wins over `rowSelection.selectedRowKeys`. Pass `rowSelection` as well to show the selection column.

selectionCell.zh-CN: 选择列的单元格，表头与数据行都调用，参数含 selected、inHeader、originNode（默认复选框）等，用 originNode 保留默认复选框。
selectionCell.en-US: A cell of the selection column, called for the header and the rows, with selected, inHeader, originNode (the default checkbox) and more. Render originNode to keep the default checkbox.

size.zh-CN: 表格尺寸，影响单元格的内边距。
size.en-US: The table size, which sets the padding of the cells.

sortIcon.zh-CN: 排序图标，参数含 sortOrder 与 column。
sortIcon.en-US: The sort icon, with sortOrder and column.

sticky.zh-CN: 将表头固定在页面顶部，传对象时 top 为距离滚动容器顶部的距离。
sticky.en-US: Sticks the header to the top of the page. With an object, top is the distance from the scroll container.

title.zh-CN: 表格标题，可以是纯文本，或带参数 pageData（当前页数据）的 snippet。
title.en-US: The table title: plain text, or a snippet with the records of the current page as pageData.

virtualized.zh-CN: 开启虚拟化，需同时传 scroll.y（数字）。对象形式可配置行高 itemSize 与额外渲染的行数 overscanCount。
virtualized.en-US: Turns on virtualization, which needs scroll.y as a number. An object sets the row height itemSize and the extra rows overscanCount.

getCurrentPageData.zh-CN: 返回当前页数据的深拷贝，含 dataSource 与 groups。
getCurrentPageData.en-US: Returns a deep copy of the data of the current page, with dataSource and groups.

scrollTo.zh-CN: 虚拟化表格滚动到指定纵向偏移，参数为像素。
scrollTo.en-US: Scrolls a virtualized table to a vertical offset, in pixels.

scrollToItem.zh-CN: 虚拟化表格滚动到指定行，第二个参数为对齐方式。
scrollToItem.en-US: Scrolls a virtualized table to a row. The second argument is the alignment.
